id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying custom source syncs on unresolvable host

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion connector reliability and resource protection
review.reason: Adds a non-retryable error classification for DNS resolution failures, preventing unnecessary retry loops and resource exhaustion during warehouse syncs. P1.F1.H1 introduces the error message and classification; P1.F2.H1 adds a test asserting this classification. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime behavior and complete implementation of the retry suppression are not fully demonstrated in the supplied hunks; the score relies on the explicit classification and test assertion rather than observed execution or broader systemic changes.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new non-retryable error classification for DNS resolution failures.
observations.code_quote: "Couldn't resolve the host": "A host in the manifest (base_url, token_url, or a resource's URL) could not be resolved via DNS. Check that it's spelled correctly and reachable from the public internet, then try again.",
observations.posthog_connection: This change updates the warehouse ingestion error classification, allowing PostHog to stop retrying warehouse syncs when a customer's configured host cannot be resolved, preventing resource exhaustion and providing a clear, permanent error message.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that DNS resolution failures are classified as non-retryable errors.
observations.code_quote: assert any(key in err for key in non_retryable)
observations.posthog_connection: This test validates that warehouse ingestion failures due to DNS issues are correctly identified and classified as permanent, non-retryable errors, ensuring reliability of the warehouse connector.
